installCommand: echo 'Flutter app build — deps via buildCommand'
buildCommand: set -e; if ! command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter config --no-analytics; fi; export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; cd ../flutter && flutter config --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE=https://fctv33-api.kedidi-anis.workers.dev && rm -rf ../web/out && mkdir -p ../web/out && cp -R build/web/. ../web/out/
